title: Server
description: The state of the server itself: power, temperatures, load, disks and updates.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the last boot.

panels.title: Mains
panels.description: Whether the charger is delivering power.

panels.title: Battery
panels.description: Charge level. The machine shuts itself down at 10% on battery.

panels.title: Battery and mains
panels.description: A power cut shows as Mains dropping to 0 and the battery draining.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: The whole processor (package). The CPU throttles at 100 °C. The gauge is now; under it, the average and the maximum over the period picked at the top right.

panels.title: GPU
panels.description: GTX 1660 Ti. Its target is 87 °C; it slows down at 95 °C. The gauge is now; under it, the average and the maximum over the period picked at the top right.

panels.title: Media disk
panels.description: The 10 TB disk, from its SMART data, read once a minute. WD gives 65 °C as its maximum. The gauge is now; under it, the average and the maximum over the period picked at the top right.

panels.title: SSD
panels.description: The NVMe system disk. Its maximum is 82 °C. The gauge is now; under it, the average and the maximum over the period picked at the top right.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: Average over the period picked at the top right.

panels.title: Memory usage
panels.description: Average over the period picked at the top right. Memory in use, not counting the file cache.

panels.title: GPU load
panels.description: Average over the period picked at the top right.

panels.title: GPU memory
panels.description: Average over the period picked at the top right. The embedding model and transcodes live here.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: In above the line, out below it.

panels.title: Disk activity
panels.description: Reads above the line, writes below it. sd is the media disk, nvme the SSD.

panels.title: Disk health
panels.description: One row per disk, from its SMART data. Reallocated and pending sectors should stay 0. The self-test runs on Sundays at 03:00; wear is reported by the SSD only.

properties.value: Hours the disk has been running since the test.

panels.title: Media disk
panels.description: While it is not mounted the media services are stopped by the disk guard.

panels.title: Free space
panels.description: / is the SSD, /data the media disk.

panels.title: Free space left
panels.description: Share of each disk that is still free. / is the SSD, /data the media disk.

panels.title: Nightly update ran
panels.description: The 04:00 run that brings in what was merged on GitHub.

panels.title: Nightly update result
panels.description: Failed means the run stopped: local edits in the checkout, or the stack did not come up. See journalctl -u server-update.

panels.title: Last update applied
panels.description: The last night that had something new to apply. Empty until the first one.

panels.title: Unattended upgrades ran
panels.description: Debian and Docker security updates, daily around 06:00.

panels.title: Reboot waiting
panels.description: An upgrade needs a reboot. The machine reboots itself at 05:00.
